name: Sudan
value: UN: 1,630+ civilians killed by drones Jan–Oct
summary: Army advances on RSF-held Al Nahud with heavy drone strikes as thousands flee; UN says drones killed 1,630+ civilians
state: Sudan's army and allies took El Khuwai on 13 Nov and are advancing on Al Nahud, West Kordofan's largest city, under intensive drone strikes, while thousands of civilians flee towards Darfur (Sudan Tribune, 15 Nov). A UN Human Rights Office report on 18 Nov said drone strikes killed more than 1,630 civilians from January to October, about 73% of 2,230 verified civilian deaths, with Kordofan worst hit (The National). Mass civilian deaths and famine in parts of the country keep the Alert.
for_you: Civilians in Kordofan and Darfur face displacement and hunger. The FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan.
rubric_hit: Alert: mass civilian deaths (UN: 1,630+ drone deaths Jan–Oct) and famine in parts of the country

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
